guitar.notes: Accurate: Paul Simon long associated with Martin and Guild acoustics.

tone.target: bright jangly folk-rock clean with acoustic-like attack
tone.profile: bright jangly folk-rock clean with acoustic-like attack
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain using light compression, a classic Fender-style amp (US Deluxe), and a bright 2x12 cabinet to capture the jangly folk sound of 'Mrs. Robinson'.

rig.name: Simon & Garfunkel - Mrs. Robinson - Valeton GP-180
